title: Lionel sings and Clastonet Ward is introduced
summary: Lionel sings I Burned Your Letter and names rock and roll as his favourite; Allen notes Punch's niece.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues
